title: First naming or recap
statement: Open: whether a lesson's key idea should first appear at the step that names it, or may be stated earlier so that the naming step lands as a recap.
detail: Two Grade 3 lesson reviews found the closing sentence already given earlier in the lesson, so the step that names it lands as a recap (`shadow/content-eval/reports/G3-U2-L1-review.md`, `shadow/content-eval/reports/G3-U1-L2-main-review.md`). One review judged that fine for learning and noted that the specification is silent on it. Nothing measured which order teaches better.

evidence.quote: The spec is silent on this.
- **p23b is not first exposure.** p19b already tells the child the sentence (*"Keep that idea close"*), so Name it lands as a recap.
